Landing.title: Know your temperament.
Landing.intro: No two bodies are the same. Understand your individual characteristics and make more informed choices about nutrition, lifestyle and care.

Landing.doctorTitle: Clinical experience. A wider view of you.
Landing.doctorText: This practice brings together temperament-related services, Iranian medicine, acupuncture, modern medicine and the clinical experience of Dr Shirmardi.
Landing.journeyEnd: What matters next is your everyday life.
Landing.journeyText: You do not need all the answers at the start. Begin with a better understanding of yourself.

steps.title: Know your temperament
steps.text: Begin with an assessment exploring your primary and secondary temperaments.

steps.title: Understand your characteristics
steps.text: Take a closer look at your habits, behavioural patterns and individual characteristics.

steps.title: Choose your next step
steps.text: Explore education, nutrition, consultation or specialist services according to your needs.

Landing.servicesTitle: Find a pathway that fits you.
Landing.servicesText: Not every service is necessary for everyone. Understand your circumstances and characteristics first, then choose a relevant next step.

services.title: Individual temperament
services.subtitle: Temperament: a key to understanding yourself and others
services.text: Explore your primary and secondary temperaments through Dr Shirmardi’s method, alongside information about personality, strengths and areas for development.

services.title: Nutrition & lifestyle
services.subtitle: What is a better fit for me?
services.text: Explore foods, their temperament-related characteristics and traditional food pairings, with step-by-step learning about everyday habits.

services.title: Weight management
services.subtitle: One approach does not fit every body
services.text: Explore weight management with attention to nutrition, individual circumstances and temperament-related characteristics.

services.title: Skin & hair
services.subtitle: Beauty does not begin only at the surface
services.text: “Lasting beauty is our work; we address both the inside and the outside.” Attention to individual factors alongside external care.

services.title: Couples temperament
services.subtitle: Understand differences before they become conflict
services.text: Explore individual and temperament-related differences before or after marriage, to encourage more informed conversation.

services.title: Online consultation
services.subtitle: When you need more than an assessment
services.text: Discuss your concerns directly, share your history and circumstances, and receive guidance based on an individual review.

Landing.nutritionTitle: “Doctor, what should I eat—and what should I avoid?”
Landing.nutritionText: Many people follow the same general advice for years, despite having different needs. In Dr Shirmardi’s approach, understanding your temperament comes before choosing a corresponding approach to nutrition.
Landing.couplesTitle: Understand differences before they become conflict.
Landing.couplesText: A closer look at individual and temperament-related differences before or after marriage. An opportunity for conversation that starts with understanding.
Landing.couplesArt: Two perspectives. A chance to understand.
Landing.visitTitle: Some concerns need more than one perspective.
Landing.visitText: Part of Dr Shirmardi’s clinical experience focuses on chronic, multifactorial and treatment-resistant concerns. His approach considers modern medicine, Iranian medicine, acupuncture and complementary methods alongside each person’s circumstances.
visitChecks: Choose a pathway suited to the individual
Landing.shopTitle: Not every product is right for every body.
Landing.shopText: Explore natural products and personal care with a better understanding of your needs. If you are unsure where to start, begin with your temperament or ask the practice for guidance.

faqs.a: If you are unsure, the individual temperament assessment offers an initial starting point. For concerns that need direct review, you can choose an online consultation.
The individual temperament assessment is offered as a free starting point. Conditions and any charges for other services are shown when you choose the service.

faqs.q: Can the assessment replace a medical consultation?
faqs.a: No. It is intended for initial understanding. Reviewing symptoms, making a diagnosis and choosing treatment require an individual assessment by a doctor.

faqs.q: Is the couples pathway only for before marriage?
faqs.a: The pathway explores individual differences both before and after marriage.

Landing.assessmentNote: This assessment offers initial understanding and does not replace medical evaluation or diagnosis.
